title: Marketing Manager
searchText: Marketing Manager Fivetran  From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About the Role This is an exciting opportunity to be our first dedicated marketing hire in Japan! As the Marketing Manager, you will play a pivotal role in establishing and growing our presence in the Japanese market. You will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive marketing strategy focused on events, content translation, case studies, and account-based marketing (ABM). This role requires a hands-on, entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with global teams. You will have the opportunity to shape our marketing efforts from the ground up and make a significant contribution to our success in Japan. This role will report directly to the Head of Marketing - APAC, based in Sydney, Australia. As our Regional Marketing Manager for Japan, you will be the driving force behind our local market presence. Success in this role means transitioning from a supportive team player to a high-energy leader who scales our regional footprint through meticulous execution and strategic alignment. You will be measured by your ability to: Drive Predictable Growth: Launch and scale a sophisticated Japan marketing motion that consistently generates a high-quality pipeline for the sales team. Establish Local Authority: Build Fivetran’s credibility by producing high-impact, local content and hosting premium events that resonate with the local market. Master Cross-Functional Rhythms: Navigate time zones and cultural nuances to establish seamless working cadences with Sales, Alliances, and Global Marketing teams. Execute with Precision: Demonstrate exceptional organisational proficiency by managing the regional budget and project timelines with increasing independence and disciplined prioritization. Cultivate Social Proof: Secure and amplify Japanese customer success stories, turning local wins into powerful proof points for the broader region. This is a full-time remote position based out of Japan. Technologies You’ll Use Marketo, Google Suite, Outreach, Height, Salesforce, Coupa, Ironclad, Salesforce, Looker What You’ll Do Plan and execute a variety of events, including conferences, roundtables, community events and webinars. This includes vendor management (sourcing, procurement), liaising with event organisers, overseeing booth builds, and managing event logistics Oversee the translation and adaptation of marketing materials (website content, brochures, presentations, etc.) for the Japanese market Develop original Japanese content, including blog posts, social media updates, and case studies, showcasing our value proposition and driving engagement Advise on local digital and direct marketing campaigns Source, order, and manage inventory of branded promotional items Work closely with the global brand/design team on asset fulfillment and management Assist in managing the marketing budget for Japan and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of marketing initiatives Partner closely with sales and business development teams on enablement of messaging for marketing campaign promotion and follow-up Align with both our Tech and SI Partner ecosystem to forge great Partnerships Skills We’re Looking For 4+ years of experience in marketing, with a strong focus on event management and content creation. Native-level fluency in Japanese and business-level proficiency in English. Proven experience in developing and executing successful marketing campaigns. Strong understanding of the Japanese business landscape and cultural nuances. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently. Experience working with the technologies listed below #LI-REMOTE #LI-LA1 Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays, and volunteer days off RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.
